Microsoft ERP/CRM Expertise of the Consultants We Provide

Strategy Planning

Our consultants for hire will help align Dynamics 365 products with your business goals. They’ll analyze your organizational needs, define objectives, and develop implementation roadmaps. By leveraging the industry’s best practices and Dynamics 365 capabilities, these professionals contribute to maximizing your ROI and creating a future-ready environment.

Mobilunity’s consultants specialize in tailoring Dynamics solutions to your specific needs. They analyze workflows, processes, and goals to create end-to-end systems. This process includes module selection, customizations, integrations, and planning for scalability. So, businesses get performance-optimized, user-friendly, and cost-effective solutions.

Architecture Planning

Engage experienced Microsoft consultants with Mobilunity to help you build resilient, secure, and scalable system infrastructures. Our professionals define data flows, platform components, and deployment environments by following best practices. This ensures a high-performing, sustainable ERP or CRM setup designed to support your operational efficiency.

Tuning / Modernization

We’ll help you contract top-tier consultants for efficient and smooth modernization and tuning of your system performance. They’ll analyze existing configurations, resolve inefficiencies, and update workflows to improve the speed and reliability of your solution. Renovation may also include integrating AI-powered tools and Power Platform to ensure your system remains up to date.

Troubleshooting

Our Microsoft Dynamics-certified consultants for hire will assist you in resolving technical issues and optimizing platform’s performance. They use advanced tools and methodologies to diagnose problems in configurations, integrations, and customizations, addressing user errors and performance bottlenecks. Such an approach keeps your suite functional and high-performing.

Migration

Contract consultants offshore to work on transferring your data and systems from legacy platforms or other CRM or ERP to Dynamics 365. Our professionals use Data Migration Framework and external ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) solutions to minimize disruptions and downtime while ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and smooth transition.

FAQs

How much does it cost to hire a Microsoft Dynamics consultant offshore with you?

The cost will depend on the specialist’s location and expertise in Dynamics and our cooperation format. Schedule a free consultation to estimate your team’s or consultant’s cost.

Do you help with technical interviews?

Absolutely. We offer technical interviews as a service, saving you time and resources in assessing candidates’ hard and soft skills to hire the best talent. Our niche professionals provide consistent, accurate evaluations and help you select the best-fitting consultants at scale.

What advantages do I get when hiring a consultant with Mobilunity?

We’ll provide highly-skilled Microsoft Dynamics advisors up to 2X faster and 2X more cost-effectively than hiring locally. Our professionals will handle the back-office support, IT infrastructure, and legal compliance.

What other consultant services do your Microsoft specialists offer?

Our specialists use advanced programming to help you with complex Dynamics implementations. They can use Docker containers to enhance the efficiency of your ERP or CRM system, integrate your suite with external apps for streamlined workflows, and manage your platform’s maintenance.

Can your consultants assist with upgrading to the latest Dynamics 365 version?

Absolutely. You can engage us to hire specialists who’ll evaluate your current version, create a detailed upgrade roadmap, clean and migrate data, configure new features, ensure seamless integration with third-party software, and provide post-upgrade support.

Is prior experience with Dynamics 365 necessary to work with your consultants?

No, you can have no understanding of Dynamics 365 CRM/ERP concepts. You only need to describe your business processes and goals, and consultants give you the rest: map your existing workflows to Dynamics 365 features and plan and implement the transition. They also provide Microsoft Dynamics training to help you get minimal technical knowledge.

How do I evaluate the return on investment (ROI) when I hire remote Microsoft Dynamics consulting professionals?

You’ll need to compare the cost of hiring consultants (fees, training, onboarding, tools) with savings and revenue growth for the period. Assess the impact of time savings for reporting, data management, and integrations, calculate cost reductions in manual labor and error corrections, and measure revenue increases attributed to improved CRM/ERP functionality.

Can Mobilumity’s consultants provide ongoing support after the implementation of Dynamics 365?

Sure. The Microsoft Dynamics consulting solutions you get from professionals hired through Mobilunity include troubleshooting, performance monitoring, feature updates, security enhancements, customizations, resolving technical issues, and other tasks related to supporting your CRM or ERP platform.
